kills.property: In the reference, lockInGuess(bytes32) can only be called successfully by an address that currently has no active guess
kills.change_summary: Replace the require that prevents re-locking (guesses[msg.sender].block == 0) with its negation, allowing lockInGuess to only be called when a guess already exists, changing post-call stored guess state for callers with prior guesses.

kills.property: For any caller and any msg.value, the reference contract requires lockInGuess to accept only calls that pay exactly 1 et
kills.change_summary: Remove the require(msg.value == 1 ether) check so callers can call lockInGuess with any value, changing whether state is updated after the call when msg.value differs.
